name: ANSI/IEEE RC network form
summary: IEEE-library form of rc network: an RC network combines resistance and capacitance in a specified circuit arrangement.
description: This reference locates rc network in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented resistive components family. An RC network combines resistance and capacitance in a specified circuit arrangement. Its function may be filtering or transient control, so the actual connection and values are needed. The public library uses HRE1RCN for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Follow the actual current path and terminal polarity in the surrounding circuit. The symbol identifies an electrical function; voltage, current, energy limits and the device package pinout come from the selected component data rather than from the outline.

Read the series or parallel topology rather than assuming one universal RC circuit. An RC network is not equivalent to a diode suppression network. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
